action.description: "review" to publish comments, finding_updates, and/or the PR overview; "none" when there is nothing to publish (no comments, no updates, no overview — never file a no-findings review).

summary.description: Overall review written in Markdown. Required for action "review"; omit for "none". Use bullet points and bold for clarity. In JSON, encode each Markdown newline once as \n; never double-escape formatting newlines as \\n.

pr_summary.description: What/Why/Risk overview of the shown diff for the PR summary block. What: bulleted file/feature changes. Why: inferred intent, labeled as inference. Risks: edge cases and follow-ups. Structure the overview with `### What`, `### Why`, and `### Risks` Markdown headings — never bold text. Markdown with single-escaped newlines; at most 2000 characters. Omit entirely for follow-up batches or when summary output is disabled.

pr_diagram.description: Raw Mermaid source (no fences) for the PR summary block, at most 1500 characters. Emit only when the diff introduces or alters a multi-component interaction (new subsystem, cross-file flow, changed state machine); prefer flowchart TD for structure and sequenceDiagram for call order. Omit for localized changes.

line.description: Positive integer line number of a changed or context line within a diff hunk. Only lines that appear in the diff can receive comments — do not comment on arbitrary lines outside the diff.

side.description: "RIGHT" for added/context lines, "LEFT" for removed lines.

body.description: Non-empty inline comment text containing meaningful prose, may use Markdown.

suggestion.description: Optional replacement code for this finding. Provide only when a concrete replacement is useful; an empty string intentionally deletes the anchored line. Applies to one RIGHT-side line, though replacement code may span multiple lines.

comments.description: Inline comments attached to specific diff lines. May be an empty array when finding_updates or the PR overview carries the review; otherwise prefer "none" over an empty review. Omit for "none".

comment_id.description: ID of an existing finding supplied in the prompt.
